detailed_description:
The target video is a living two-color risograph print in <Subject 1>: every shape keeps its orange and blue ink grain, hatching and slight misregistration as it moves, like animated screen-printed frames.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The raised hands pump to the beat and the light burst flickers like a strobe. The camera rises straight up out of the crowd at a steady speed in one continuous move, the hands dropping away below as the view opens up over the whole packed street, the haze and strobe beams sweeping across it, until the towering wall of sound-system speakers appears at the far end in the center. The camera is still rising as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
